text: What if all copper vanished for five seconds? Bad news. Everything you own just died.
Every wire on Earth. Gone. Power lines are just poles. The internet is over.
Your car had up to a mile of wire. Engine dead. Everybody coasts.
Every elevator stops between floors. Some guy is stuck with Greg from accounting. Greg has a podcast.
Water pipes. Gone. Your bathroom is a fountain. You run. Your keys are brass. That's copper. Locked out of your own flood.
Lady Liberty's skin is copper, two pennies thick. Gone. New York is staring at an iron skeleton.
Copper is back. Every alarm on Earth goes off.
You're alive. Soaked. And somewhere, an elevator lights up. Greg is on episode two.
